title: Page shell
summary: The frame of one page: a pk-page-header (breadcrumb, title, actions, a docked tab strip) above one content region. A whole-page state (loading, empty, error, forbidden) replaces the content. The spacing between header and content is the shell's own, so a page declares none. Tabs: one content region, and the page swaps what it renders when the tab strip fires pk-tab-change.

props.name: heading
props.description: The page title, drawn by the header.

props.name: level
props.description: The heading level the title exposes to assistive technology. A page title is 1.

props.name: crumbs
props.description: The breadcrumb trail as a JSON array of { "label", "href" }, as on pk-page-header. Use it instead of the breadcrumb slot.

props.name: backLink
props.description: Draws a back link to the last crumb that has a usable href.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Pins the header (with its tabs) to the top of the scrolling page body.

props.name: state
props.description: ready shows the content. Any other value shows that whole-page state in its place and hides the content (it stays in the DOM). The header and its tabs stay.

props.name: stateHeading
props.description: The state's heading (the loading label for loading). Empty uses a default per state.

props.name: stateDescription
props.description: The line under the state's heading (the error message for error).

slots.description: The page content, one region. Hidden while a whole-page state shows.

slots.name: breadcrumb
slots.description: A pk-breadcrumb above the title, instead of crumbs.

slots.name: title
slots.description: A pk-heading for the title, in place of the built-in text.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Buttons at the right of the title bar. Give each an icon-name and collapse="phone".

slots.name: meta
slots.description: A note line under the title bar.

slots.name: tabs
slots.description: A pk-tabs strip (tabs only) docked at the foot of the header.

events.name: pk-page-shell-retry
events.description: Retry was pressed in the error state: load again, then set state back to ready.

parts.name: state
parts.description: The whole-page state, drawn only while state is not ready.

parts.name: content
parts.description: The region holding the default slot.

cssProperties.name: --pk-page-shell-gap
cssProperties.description: The space between the header, the state and the content.

a11y: The title is the header's real heading at level (1 for a page). The state region is a status role, so a loading or error state is announced; the tab strip keeps its own tablist semantics.

examples.title: Header, tabs and content
examples.html:
<pk-page-shell heading="PO 1042" crumbs='[{"label":"Stock","href":"#"},{"label":"Purchase orders","href":"#"},{"label":"PO 1042"}]'>
  <pk-button slot="actions" icon-name="import" collapse="phone">Receive</pk-button>
  <pk-tabs slot="tabs">
    <pk-tab value="lines">Lines</pk-tab>
    <pk-tab value="history">History</pk-tab>
  </pk-tabs>
  <pk-card heading="Lines">Three lines, 412.00 in total.</pk-card>
</pk-page-shell>

examples.title: A whole-page error state
examples.html:
<pk-page-shell heading="Orders" state="error" state-heading="Could not load orders" state-description="The request failed.">
  <pk-card heading="Orders">Hidden while the error shows.</pk-card>
</pk-page-shell>
